title.hr: Dvije kockice: koji je zbroj najvjerojatniji?
title.en: Two dice: which sum is most likely?

concept.hr: Siguran, moguć i nemoguć događaj; zbroj 7 ima 6 načina; pravedna igra
concept.en: Certain, possible and impossible events; a sum of 7 has 6 ways; a fair game

summary.hr: Bacaj dvije kockice i gledaj kako rastu crtice, pogledaj svih 36 parova, odigraj utrku do 10 i odluči je li igra pravedna.
summary.en: Throw two dice and watch the tally grow, see all 36 pairs, play the race to 10 and decide whether a game is fair.

concept.hr: Predvidi koji će zbroj pasti najčešće, pa bacaj i broji crticama
concept.en: Predict which sum comes up most often, then throw and tally

title.en: 36 pairs: why 7 is the most likely

concept.hr: Zbroj 7 ima 6 načina, 2 i 12 samo jedan; 1 i 13 nijedan
concept.en: A sum of 7 has 6 ways, 2 and 12 only one; 1 and 13 none

concept.hr: Dvanaest igrača s brojevima 1 do 12: je li utrka pravedna?
concept.en: Twelve players numbered 1 to 12: is the race fair?

title.en: Odd or even: a fair game

concept.hr: Paran i neparan zbroj imaju po 18 načina
concept.en: An even and an odd sum have 18 ways each
